label_rationale: Draft instrument-metadata policy reference. A current linked fault assigns its domain unless a normal report contradicts the same measured function under the same declared conditions, or a relevant eligible report has unresolved scope. Distinct declared functions or conditions are compatible. Stale and unlinked reports cannot create a scope block.
